title: Etale affine qcoherent acyclicity in successor degree
statement: For every natural number n, higher etale cohomology in degree n+1 of the associated quasi-coherent sheaf on an affine scheme is subsingleton.

proof.text: Let G be the original tensor-section sheaf and Gprime its coefficient lift. Use etale_affine_qcoherent_ulift to obtain Subsingleton (Sheaf.H Gprime (n+1)). This retains the finite affine basis, faithfully flat Amitsur Cech calculation, and Cech criterion through that existing theorem.

Let T be the identity etale object, terminal by MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal. Choose an injective resolution R of G. The coefficient-lift resolution theorem supplies a resolution S of Gprime and an isomorphism between its evaluation complex at T and the coefficient lift of the evaluation complex of R. The Ext/right-derived evaluation comparison and S.isoRightDerivedObj turn the lifted cohomology vanishing into zero homology of evaluated S.

Map the evaluation-complex isomorphism to homology. Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identifies the composite map functor, and ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor identifies lifted homology with the lift of the small homology group. Transport IsZero along these isomorphisms; ULift.up is injective, so the small homology group is subsingleton too. R.isoRightDerivedObj and the Ext/right-derived terminal evaluation comparison then give the original Sheaf.H subsingleton. The existing arbitrary-positive-degree wrapper is unchanged.

The adopted source theorem etale_affine_qcoherent carries out the preceding argument for every positive q. Specialize it to q = n + 1 with Nat.zero_lt_succ n. Thus the successor statement needs no separate Sheaf module; the arbitrary-positive-degree wrapper is also already the source theorem.

proof_origin.place: Affine Cech/Amitsur argument, implemented in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleAffineQcoherent; specialize its positive-degree theorem to n + 1. C9 retirement, 2026-10-20.
